itens.trecho: Yellowjackets – Temporada 3: começa bem, mas perde-se a meio - COM SPOILERS Comecei a ver esta terceira temporada com boas expectativas. Os primeiros episódios mostraram que ainda havia bastante para explorar, especialmente na linha temporal dos anos 90. O ambiente continuava intenso, sombrio, e as relações entre as raparigas estavam cada vez mais tensas.

I gave this TV show 7/10. I would give it more but Americans are pushing propaganda hard lately and this TV show didn't survive it either. Good things: TV show has interesting story. Has good soundtracks. Has good character development. I like shows and movies like this - mystery especially tied to supernatural and cults.
